items.label: Reliable Support for Climbing Plants
items.value: Designed to support cucumbers, tomatoes, peas, beans and other vine crops, this U-shaped garden trellis helps plants grow upward for better airflow, cleaner growth and easier harvesting

items.label: Ideal for Raised Garden Beds
items.value: The arch-style structure fits raised beds and garden boxes while creating a practical climbing space for vegetables. It helps guide vines upward without taking over your planting area

items.label: Make More Use of Vertical Space
items.value: Grow more in limited garden space. This trellis encourages vertical growth, helping keep plants organized while making your garden look tidier and easier to manage

items.label: Strong Frame for Everyday Garden Use
items.value: Built with sturdy metal tubes and reinforced connectors, the trellis provides dependable support for climbing plants throughout the growing season

items.label: Easy to Assemble and Use
items.value: Simple structure and straightforward assembly make this plant trellis easy to set up in raised beds, garden soil or other outdoor growing spaces, whether you are a beginner or experienced gardener
